1333: 		 * Sets the {@link ResizerFactory} object to use to decide what kind of
1334: 		 * resizing operation is to be used when creating the thumbnail.
1335: 		 * <p>
1336: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1337: 		 * <p>
1338: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1339: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1340: 		 * <p>
1341: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1342: 		 * {@link #resizer(Resizer)} method.
1343: 		 * 
1344: 		 * @param resizerFactory		The scaling operation to use.
1345: 		 * @return						Reference to this object.
1346: 		 * @since	0.4.0
1347: 		 */
1348: 		public Builder<T> resizerFactory(ResizerFactory resizerFactory) {
1349: 			checkForNull(resizerFactory, "ResizerFactory is null.");
1350: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1351: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1352: 			
1353: 			// disable the methods which set parameters for the Resizer
1354: 			updateStatus(Properties.SCALING_MODE, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1355: 			updateStatus(Properties.ALPHA_INTERPOLATION, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1356: 			updateStatus(Properties.DITHERING, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1357: 			updateStatus(Properties.ANTIALIASING, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1358: 			updateStatus(Properties.RENDERING, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1359: 			
1360: 			this.resizerFactory = resizerFactory;
1361: 			return this;
1362: 		}
1363: 		
1364: 		/**
1365: 		 * Sets the alpha interpolation mode when performing the resizing
1366: 		 * operation to generate the thumbnail.
1367: 		 * <p>
1368: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1369: 		 * <p>
1370: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1371: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1372: 		 * <p>
1373: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1374: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1375: 		 * 
1376: 		 * @param config		The alpha interpolation mode.
1377: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1378: 		 */
1379: 		public Builder<T> alphaInterpolation(AlphaInterpolation config) {
1380: 			checkForNull(config, "Alpha interpolation is null.");
1381: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1382: 			updateStatus(Properties.ALPHA_INTERPOLATION, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1383: 			alphaInterpolation = config;
1384: 			return this;
1385: 		}
1386: 
1387: 		/**
1388: 		 * Sets the dithering mode when performing the resizing
1389: 		 * operation to generate the thumbnail.
1390: 		 * <p>
1391: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1392: 		 * <p>
1393: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1394: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1395: 		 * <p>
1396: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1397: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1398: 		 * 
1399: 		 * @param config		The dithering mode.
1400: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1401: 		 */
1402: 		public Builder<T> dithering(Dithering config) {
1403: 			checkForNull(config, "Dithering is null.");
1404: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1405: 			updateStatus(Properties.DITHERING, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1406: 			dithering = config;
1407: 			return this;
1408: 		}
1409: 		
1410: 		/**
1411: 		 * Sets the antialiasing mode when performing the resizing
1412: 		 * operation to generate the thumbnail.
1413: 		 * <p>
1414: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1415: 		 * <p>
1416: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1417: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException}.
1418: 		 * <p>
1419: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1420: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1421: 		 * 
1422: 		 * @param config		The antialiasing mode.
1423: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1424: 		 */
1425: 		public Builder<T> antialiasing(Antialiasing config) {
1426: 			checkForNull(config, "Antialiasing is null.");
1427: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1428: 			updateStatus(Properties.ANTIALIASING, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1429: 			antialiasing = config;
1430: 			return this;

1432: 		
1433: 		/**
1434: 		 * Sets the rendering mode when performing the resizing
1435: 		 * operation to generate the thumbnail.
1436: 		 * <p>
1437: 		 * Calling this method to set this parameter is optional.
1438: 		 * <p>
1439: 		 * Calling this method multiple times will result in an
1440: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1441: 		 * <p>
1442: 		 * This method cannot be called in conjunction with the
1443: 		 * {@link #resizerFactory(ResizerFactory)} method.
1444: 		 * 
1445: 		 * @param config		The rendering mode.
1446: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1447: 		 */
1448: 		public Builder<T> rendering(Rendering config) {
1449: 			checkForNull(config, "Rendering is null.");
1450: 			updateStatus(Properties.RESIZER_FACTORY, Status.CANNOT_SET);
1451: 			updateStatus(Properties.RENDERING, Status.ALREADY_SET);
1452: 			rendering = config;
1453: 			return this;
1454: 		}
1455: 		
1456: 		/**
1457: 		 * Sets whether or not to keep the aspect ratio of the original image
1458: 		 * for the thumbnail.
1459: 		 * <p>
1460: 		 * Calling this method without first calling the {@link #size(int, int)}
1461: 		 * method will result in an {@link IllegalStateException} to be thrown.
1462: 		 * <p>
1463: 		 * If this method is not called when, by default the aspect ratio of
1464: 		 * the original image is preserved for the thumbnail.
1465: 		 * <p>
1466: 		 * Calling this method after calling the {@link #scale(double)} method
1467: 		 * or the {@link #scale(double, double)} method will result in a
1468: 		 * {@link IllegalStateException}.
1469: 		 * 
1470: 		 * @param keep			{@code true} if the thumbnail is to maintain
1471: 		 * 						the aspect ratio of the original image,
1472: 		 * 						{@code false} otherwise.
1473: 		 * @return				Reference to this object.
1474: 		 * 
1475: 		 * @throws IllegalStateException	If
1476: 		 * 									<ol>
1477: 		 * 									<li>the {@link #size(int, int)} has
1478: 		 * 									not yet been called to specify the
1479: 		 * 									size of the thumbnail, or</li>
1480: 		 * 									<li>the {@link #scale(double)}
1481: 		 * 									method has been called, or</li>
1482: 		 * 									<li>the
1483: 		 * 									{@link #scale(double, double)}
1484: 		 * 									method has been called, or</li>
1485: 		 * 									<li>the {@link #width(int)} and/or
1486: 		 * 									{@link #height(int)} has been called
1487: 		 * 									and not preserving the aspect ratio
1488: 		 * 									is desired.</li>
